rationale: All 8 runs are feasible with headroom (hold >= +0.079 ns, 0 DRC, <=18 slew/cap pins vs bar 89), so only T_eff matters. Except des (DELAY 4, no timing-driven placement, no synthesis buffering/sizing: 7.78 ns, avoid), the ~5 ns-target runs met their targets with positive slack (md5 +0.30, bm64 +0.23), so the timing wall is not reached: push the target to the 0.45 floor (4.5 ns). Setting 1 = best run (md5: AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, both post-GRT repairs, cap213) at 4.5 ns with slightly larger repair margins. Setting 2 = identical but DELAY 3 (bm64's strategy) to isolate the synthesis-strategy effect.
